description: Figure 6 is a line plot illustrating the proportion of harmful responses in which the model exhibited a rejection tendency, as a function of an increasing numeric variable on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with values 128, 256, 512, and 1024, suggesting a logarithmic or discrete step progression, though it is plotted on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. Four distinct lines represent different model-benchmark combinations: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares, solid line), LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds, solid line). All lines show an upward trend as the x-axis value increases. At x=128, the ratios are approximately 0.20 (blue), 0.15 (orange), 0.07 (green), and 0.24 (red). At x=1024, the ratios rise to approximately 0.36 (blue), 0.42 (orange), 0.38 (green), and 0.52 (red). The red line (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) consistently remains the highest across all x-values, while the green line (LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) starts the lowest but rises steeply, surpassing the blue and orange lines by x=512. The orange and red lines plateau slightly between x=512 and x=1024, while the blue and green lines continue to increase more steadily.
